recommendation.description: APPROVE when the assigned task deliverable is complete, evidence-based and fit to proceed. CHANGES_REQUIRED only when the deliverable itself is materially incomplete, unsupported, contradictory, or fails its acceptance criteria. Product defects discovered by the deliverable are not by themselves a reason to request changes.

missing_required_outputs.description: Material outputs required by the original owner role/task that are absent from the delivered report.

deliverable_defects.description: Concrete defects of the deliverable itself. Product defects merely documented by a valid audit/planning deliverable do not belong here.
